My dear [Miss Smith](../persons.html#263),
I send you an [order](../others.html#102) for the chapters of the Thorne that have appeared- also another to correct. I think people like it much - your neighbour [Miss Wilford](../persons.html#1520) was talking about it yesterday she is staying with [her aunt](../persons.html#384) at [St Cross](../others.html#130), and I am always much tempted to betray you

yours sincerely

C M Yonge
The Order is payable to Ann Smith - more names always cause blunders
